coverage_explanation: Checks all three physical color channels through two complete cycles and the start of a third. Samples on both sides of the first three transitions constrain the 3-second phase durations with 200 ms settling allowance. Initialization off is treated as a transient initialization action, not an unspecified extra off phase before the first red phase.
assumptions: The supplied Mega 2560 circuit overrides the prose reference to UNO.
The common cathode is grounded, so HIGH illuminates each channel: red pin 2, green pin 3, blue pin 4. No bench-default wiring is needed.
No startup off dwell is specified; the reference initializes all channels off and then immediately begins the first red phase.
The specified color combinations use fully on or fully off channels.
